_notes: Episode 2 — original rule: 'If your room ever has two doors'. cap: *bright* emphasis, !red! danger, {TEXT:N} replaces N spoken words.

lines.tts: If you ever wake up and your room has two doors,
lines.cap: If you ever wake up and your room has !two! !doors,!

lines.tts: never open the one that wasn't there before.
It's easy to spot.
It's always a little too tall.
At three A.M., it starts knocking.
Three knocks.
Then three more.
Then it calls your name,
in your mom's voice.
Don't answer.
Your mom never knocks.
When the handle starts to turn, get out of bed.
lines.cap: When the handle starts to !turn,! get out of bed.

lines.tts: Walk to the real door. Slowly.
Don't run. It can hear running.
Lock yourself in the bathroom,
and don't come out until the sun is up.
lines.cap: and don't come out until the *sun* *is* *up.*

lines.tts: In the morning, the extra door will be gone.
lines.cap: In the morning, the extra door will be *gone.*

lines.tts: But your mom will ask why you knocked on her door last night,
lines.cap: But your mom will ask why you !knocked! on her door last night,

lines.tts: calling her name in your voice.
Let's hope she didn't open it.
Would you have answered? Tell me in the comments.
lines.cap: Would you have *answered?* Tell me in the *comments.*

lines.tts: And follow for more rules.
